description: This file defines the Percentiles class with static methods for statistical calculations such as percentile, percentile rank, quartile, and rank, used within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: Percentiles
classes.description: A class providing static methods for statistical percentile calculations within PhpSpreadsheet.

methods.name: PERCENTILE
methods.description: Calculates the nth percentile of a set of values.

methods.name: PERCENTRANK
methods.description: Returns the rank of a value in a data set as a percentage.

methods.name: QUARTILE
methods.description: Calculates the quartile of a data set.

methods.name: RANK
methods.description: Returns the rank of a number within a list of numbers.
